jobs.description_text: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia. Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico. Come lavoriamo Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere. Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera. La tecnologia al servizio di tutti Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia. jobs.title: Superviseur·se CVC/HAVC - Pompes à chaleur - France
jobs.description_text: Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et la satisfaction client. Notre objectif est clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance ! Dans le cadre du lancement et du déploiement de nos pompes à chaleur en France, nous recherchons notre premier·ère Superviseur·ise CVC/HVAC pour superviser les installations de nos pompes à chaleur air-air. Nous recherchons une personne passionnée, ayant de l’expérience dans l’installation de pompes à chaleur et/ou systèmes de chauffage et désireuse de nous aider à développer cette activité en France. Il s’agit d’un poste sur le terrain couvrant la région d’Amiens, mais tu seras également amené·e à travailler depuis ton domicile ou depuis notre bureau de Lille lorsque cela sera nécessaire.

jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: Why This Role Exists Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Go)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU You will play a pivotal role in delivering high-impact software solutions across our platform. You bring curiosity, initiative, and a passion for clean, scalable systems. You collaborate effectively with teammates and cross-functional partners to design, build, and improve our technical stack. You’re hands-on, deeply engaged in the code, and consistently seeking better ways to solve complex engineering challenges.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Partnerships
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Backend Engineer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working alongside our HQ Integration Management and Engineering teams. Your job is to make partnerships technically real: turning an inbound partnerships inquiry into a working integration, generating and serving the affiliate and referral links that Traffic Source Partners use, and making sure the traffic those links carry lands correctly in our Web Shops and is attributed all the way through to a purchase. You will write the backend that sits between a partner and our commerce platform — link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution pass-through, postbacks, and the reporting endpoints that feed partner payouts. You will also build the internal tooling that lets the Partnerships and Customer Success teams onboard partners and reconcile payouts without hand-editing spreadsheets. This is an entry-level engineering role with genuine product surface area. Recent graduates and career-changers with a strong project portfolio are welcome. If you like small, well-scoped systems that other people depend on daily, and you want to learn commerce, attribution, and payments engineering from a team that runs it at global scale, we would love to hear from you. jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE: Xsolla is an international IT company that offers a number of services for video games. We create solutions for developers that help to integrate payments, attract users, and publish games all over the world. We also provide round-the-clock technical support. We are trusted by such giants as Twitch, Valve, Epic Games, Take2 and many more. As a Business Development Manager at Xsolla you will be responsible for researching, understanding, and selling Xsolla's products and solutions to clients in Global. Your primary functions will be sourcing and building new partnerships with individuals in the video game community and closing deals. Since this role is connected to the company strategy you will be able to influence decisions on a global level and the director role.

jobs.title: Business Development Operation Intern
jobs.description_text: About this position We are looking for a Business Development Support Intern to work closely with the marketing team, managing and coordinating the BD team's schedule. The role involves using AI tools to clean leads, organize and update accounts, and provide data support to the sales team. This internship requires at least three days of attendance per week, with an immediate start date. If you have fluent English reading and writing skills and are curious about business development, we welcome you to join us.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Partnerships
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Customer Success Manager at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok. You will work side by side with our HQ and APAC Customer Success Managers, supporting the day-to-day success of the Traffic Source Partners we onboard — affiliates, media partners, creator networks, and publishers who drive players to the web shops we operate for game developers. The centre of gravity of this role is account management operations, and in particular partner payouts:making sure every partner is set up correctly, that their performance data is accurate, that their payout is calculated, documented, approved and paid on time, and that any discrepancy is chased down and closed. It is detailed work that partners feel immediately — getting it right is how trust in the programme gets built. This is an entry-level position with real ownership from day one. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply, provided you have the right attitude and eagerness to learn. If you are organised, comfortable with numbers, enjoy being the reliable person other teams can count on, and want to learn the commercial side of the games industry from the inside, we would love to hear from you. jobs.title: Dubai Events Community Manager, MENA
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Dubai Events Community Manager who is trustworthy, self-driven, motivated, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team. The ideal candidate is a natural relationship-builder who thrives on turning event moments into lasting community connections across MENA's games industry, anchored by activity at the Xsolla Club in Dubai. You will use your community management, content, and relationship-building skills to grow and nurture Xsolla's network of partners, developers and clients in the region, working closely with the Dubai events team, Social Media Manager, and Marketing colleagues. The right person for this role will be personable, organized, and confident engaging senior industry stakeholders, with a strong instinct for the kind of content and touchpoints that keep a community engaged between events. This role is in-office/on-site at Xsolla's new Dubai Club and will require occasional regional travel for events. Longevity Opportunity Vision — Enjoy the game!

jobs.title: Dubai Events Coordinator, MENA
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Dubai Events Coordinator who is trustworthy, self-driven, motivated, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team as a founding member of Xsolla's new Dubai hub. The ideal candidate brings strong local market knowledge of Dubai and the wider UAE, and is passionate about delivering polished, well-run events, including Xsolla's presence at the DFGC/Xsolla events expo and the Xsolla Club in Dubai. You will use your local vendor and venue relationships, planning skills, and attention to detail to ensure Xsolla's Dubai-hosted events run smoothly and reflect genuine local market understanding, working closely with the Event Operations Manager and regional colleagues. The right person for this role will be a proactive, personable coordinator who can navigate the local UAE events landscape and build strong on-the-ground vendor and partner relationships. This role is in-office/on-site at Xsolla's new Dubai hub and will require occasional local and regional travel. Longevity Opportunity Vision — Enjoy the game!

jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator, MENA
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for an Event Operations Coordinator, MENA who is trustworthy, self-driven, motivated, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, cross-functional and multicultural environment and is eager to help bring major global conference and event brands into Xsolla's new Dubai events hub and Expo venue. You will work closely with the Event Operations Manager, the Director of Marketing EMEA and the Global Head of Event Sales to support the deal process, sales logistics and account management for event organizers hosted at the Xsolla Dubai Expo venue. The right person for this role will be detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable supporting multiple organizer accounts and deal pipelines under tight deadlines—an ideal role for someone early-to-mid career in events or account management who wants to grow with a new regional hub. This role is in-office/on-site at Xsolla's new Dubai hub and will require regional travel of up to 15-20%.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager, MENA
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for an Event Operations Manager, MENA who is trustworthy, self-driven, motivated, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, cross-functional and multicultural environment and is passionate about bringing major global conference and event brands to Xsolla's new Dubai events hub and Expo venue. You will work closely with the Director of Marketing EMEA and the Global Head of Event Sales to manage relationships with the event organizers Xsolla brings to the region, owning the deal process, sales logistics and account management that gets each event successfully set up and delivered in the Xsolla Dubai Expo venue. The right person for this role will be a strong relationship manager, negotiator, and project owner who can manage multiple organizer accounts at once, build a team from the ground up, and turn commercial agreements into flawless on-site delivery. This role is in-office/on-site at Xsolla's new Dubai hub and will require regional and international travel of up to 25-30%.

jobs.title: Junior Developer (AI Engineering)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Junior Developer (AI Engineering) to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) team, a platform that connects game studios and publishers with content creators. The position involves participation in all stages of work on an automated content generation system: from stabilising the existing vertical video pipeline for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels to developing the agentic architecture, launching the virtual AI creator direction and building analytics on the results. Working with the team means applying cutting-edge generative models and agentic tools to a real production product every day, seeing the direct effect of your work in content metrics, and learning from the inside how the games industry, the creator economy and content-driven game promotion work. The developer will work with a live system that has a real audience and measurable results, make technical decisions independently, build expertise in generative AI and take on the role of the project's technical owner as it grows.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who is meticulous, technically sharp, and forward-thinking to join our engineering team. You thrive in fast-paced, agile environments and are passionate about ensuring quality at every stage of the development lifecycle. You are not only confident in manual testing but also eager to integrate AI driven testing tools and workflows to elevate productivity, test coverage, and defect detection. You bring deep expertise in exploratory and structured testing, contribute to team best practices, and are proactive in monitoring production behavior and user experiences. You stay curious about emerging tools and technologies, especially AI, and know how to leverage them effectively without losing sight of the fundamentals. jobs.title: Partner Success Manager, China & APAC
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Partner Success Manager to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) Business Development team, based in China. This is a newly created, hybrid role sitting within the core XPN BD team — roughly 80% campaign and partner success, 20% business development support — created to close a gap in how XPN partners are supported once a deal closes: campaigns are launched, but no one consistently owns their ongoing success. The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Full ownership of the sales process (sourcing, pitching, commercial negotiation) sits with the Core China/APAC Team; this role isn't required to run a deal end-to-end, but is expected to help get opportunities over the line and make sure they deliver once signed. If you're excited about building a new function from the ground up, becoming a product expert partners and internal teams rely on, and working across both Chinese and global creator platforms as publishers look to expand their reach, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Product / Web Designer, Partnerships
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Product / Web Designer at junior level to join our APAC Partnerships team in Vladivostok, working with our HQ Design team. This role is the design half of a two-person build pair: you and the Partnerships Backend Engineer take an inbound partnerships inquiry and turn it into something a player actually sees — a co-branded web shop, a campaign landing page, a creator or affiliate destination page — and ship it together. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody.
